method: The points field retains approximate digitized Star History values for DeepSeek Harness, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw, rounded to 100 stars/calendar day. Repository stars do not measure product users or quality.

forecastMethod: DeepSeek rates are average daily additions over 7/14/30-day windows, using linear interpolation of sampled historical values. Slower: daily additions halve every 30 days. Steady: constant additions. Faster: 1.5 times the selected daily rate. Scenarios are illustrative and not confidence intervals.
comparisonMethod: The switchable comparison uses GitHub aggregate star additions, grouped into weekly endpoints and back-calculated from the October 3, 2026 snapshot. Historical totals are estimates: removed stars are not accounted for and API calendar boundaries may differ from UTC. Some series cover only the retrieved recent period; repositories without aggregate history appear only as snapshot dots. The original three-project charts and DeepSeek projection retain their earlier sampled histories.
